# A book holding US dollars that no cost basis can speak for, and one cost
# basis spent to the last cent.
#
# `Assets:USD Spent` bought 100.00 USD at 1.30 and sold every one of them
# against that basis, so the basis stays on the book reading 0.00 — a row with
# no units left to draw on. `Assets:USD Held` was paid 500.00 USD in a
# transaction stated wholly in US dollars, which says nothing about what they
# cost, so no cost basis was opened for them at all.
#
# Spending those dollars is therefore not refused for saying no cost basis guid:
# the refusal asks first whether the book keeps a basis on that side that could
# be drawn on, and the only one here holds nothing. A reader sent to a listing
# of one row they could not have used would be worse than not being asked.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_a_disposal_is_allowed_where_no_cost_basis_can_be_drawn_on.py.
2034-01-01 commodity CAD
	mnemonic: "CAD"
	fullname: "Canadian Dollar"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 100
2034-01-01 commodity USD
	mnemonic: "USD"
	fullname: "US Dollar"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 100
2034-01-01 open Assets
	type: "Asset"
	placeholder: #True
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

2034-01-02 * "Opening capital"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:CAD Bank 5000.00 CAD
	Equity:Opening -5000.00 CAD

2034-01-05 * "Buy 100.00 USD at 1.30"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:USD Spent 100.00 USD
		guid: "f6f6f6f6f6f6f6f6f6f6f6f6f6f60001"
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "13/10"
		value: "130.00"
	Assets:CAD Bank -130.00 CAD

# Every one of them sold, so the cost basis is left reading 0.00.
2034-02-10 * "Sell all 100.00 USD at 1.35"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:USD Spent -100.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "13/10"
		value: "-130.00"
		cost_basis_split_guid: "f6f6f6f6f6f6f6f6f6f6f6f6f6f60001"
	Assets:CAD Bank 135.00 CAD
	Income:FX Gain $residual$ CAD

# Borrowed in a transaction stated wholly in US dollars, so there is no Canadian
# figure in it to say what either side cost and neither side opens a cost basis.
2034-03-01 * "Borrow 500.00 USD"
	currency.mnemonic: "USD"
	Assets:USD Held 500.00 USD
		guid: "f6f6f6f6f6f6f6f6f6f6f6f6f6f60002"
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
	Liabilities:USD Loan -500.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
